snippets.title: Metered session route in a payments proxy (server)
snippets.note: Shortened from the README payments proxy example: one route charges per call, one meters per token through a Tempo session.

snippets.title: CLI: pay, choose protocol, close sessions
snippets.code:
# create account - stored in keychain, autofunded on testnet
mppx account create

# make request - automatic payment handling
mppx example.com

# pay an x402 offer on a server that advertises both protocols
mppx example.com --protocol x402

# inspect and close retained sessions
mppx sessions list
mppx sessions close --all --yes
snippets.note: From the README CLI section. Session channels are kept until you close them, which matters because Tempo session channels never expire.
